name: Bjørn Arnesen
bio:
Bjørn Arnesen's passion for motorsport ignited during his childhood, fueled by attending local rallycross events in his hometown. He started his motorsport journey by tinkering with go-karts, quickly demonstrating a knack for understanding vehicle dynamics. Despite his young age, Bjørn possesses a sharp strategic mind and an unwavering belief in his vision for success. He strives to foster a collaborative environment where innovation and calculated risk-taking are encouraged. 

Bjørn approaches his role as team principal with a modern outlook. He emphasizes data-driven decision-making, constantly seeking ways to optimize performance through innovative strategies and cutting-edge technologies. While he's still developing his management skills, his hands-on approach and willingness to learn from his team make him a promising leader. He is currently working to refine his technical skills, shadowing senior engineers and attending specialized courses.

What sets Bjørn apart is his relentless pursuit of unconventional solutions. He isn't afraid to challenge established norms and is willing to take calculated gambles to gain a competitive edge. His visionary leadership, combined with his hands-on approach, makes him a unique and potentially disruptive force in the motorsport world.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly parted with a slight wave
physical.description: Bjørn has a lean build and an intense, focused gaze.

quirks: Always sketches racing lines on napkins during meetings.
Insists on starting every day with a cup of strong black coffee and a detailed review of the weather forecast.
Has a habit of pacing around the garage while deep in thought, often muttering to himself.
